rules.name: Basic worker check
rules.description: Worker must be online and unlocked

rules.name: Worker context status check
rules.description: Worker without a scheduling resource is allowed; otherwise the resource must be allocatable

rules.name: Routing country match
rules.description: Routing country, when required, must match worker scheduling routing tags

rules.name: Worker capability check
rules.description: Project support gates generic tasks; SDK event tasks use explicit worker event capability
rules.content: ((taskEventCode == null || taskEventCode == '') && supportsProject == true) || ((taskEventCode != null && taskEventCode != '') && supportsEvent == true)

rules.name: Worker load check
rules.description: Worker-supported project count must stay below 10
